key_stat: Closed-loop network | Premium brand | Gen Z/Millennial growth strategy
summary: American Express is a premium-focused payments company with a closed-loop network. Q2 2025: $17.86B revenue (+9%), $2.89B net income. Strategy: premium card member acquisition (Gen Z/Millennial cohort growth), travel and lifestyle experiences (Centurion Lounges), merchant partnerships, SME services. Technology: AI fraud detection, personalisation, customer service. Digital assets: cautious — Amex Passport NFTs, CEO acknowledges stablecoins but not prioritising. Coinbase co-branded Amex card. Behind Visa and Mastercard on digital asset infrastructure.

business_segments.name: US Consumer Services
business_segments.detail: Premium cards (Platinum, Gold, Green). Membership rewards. Travel (Centurion Lounges). Consumer lending.

business_segments.name: Commercial Services
business_segments.detail: Small business cards/lending. Corporate cards. B2B payments. Expense management.

business_segments.name: Global Merchant & Network Services
business_segments.detail: Merchant acquiring. Network fees. Closed-loop network. Digital acceptance.

technology.ai: Real-time fraud screening. Personalisation engine. AI customer service. Predictive credit risk.
technology.data: Transaction data analytics. Customer behavioural insights. Merchant data.
technology.platforms: Amex mobile app. Travel booking. Merchant acceptance.

operating_model: Premium brand positioning. Gen Z/Millennial acquisition. Travel/experience economy focus. Digital-first card application/servicing. Closed-loop network advantage for data.
competitive_position: Premium card network. Closed-loop data advantage. Behind Visa/Mastercard on digital. Strong loyalty. Competing: Visa (network), Chase (cards), Capital One.
